segments.text: action. Welcome to the last X-Tool video. In the last video we got a demonstration of how to
run the laser to make this design and now it is time for you to come in and get to make your own.
So the next step for you is to come in and complete this short quiz. I've given you all
of the answers in these videos. You are able to take it as many times as you need. We also make
it open note. So we do have this lovely binder which is a written version of this training. It
has all of the same info we talked about today with pictures and you are allowed to use this binder
both during the quiz and anytime you might need a refresher on anything. After you have taken and
passed the quiz we will give you this sheet of instructions and a sheet of basswood like we used
in our video today and you'll make your very own ruler with your name instead of mine. Once you have
that you will get to get a workbench card if you don't already have one and we will engrave your
laser badge on the workbench card. After that you'll be able to start reserving the machine.
You'll need to both reserve a time for the badge project and then after that you'll just
reserve time on the machine to come in and use it. We're going to very briefly go over
how to reserve workbench equipment. You're going to start at our website bozemanlibrary.org
and then come right over here to the I want to tab. From here you're going to go to reserve
workbench equipment. That's going to pull up a second menu where you're going to once again
select workbench equipment and then you will see a list of all of our available machines.
Most of them require trainings just like you've gone through for the laser so if you'd like to
come back and use the embroidery machine or the Cricut we will have you go through a training.
The only ones that don't require training are the sewing machines and the recording studio.
To reserve time on a machine you can select any available green squares. Each square is 30
minutes and you can reserve up to two hours per day. So here I can see that I've got it reserved
from 12 to 2. You can reserve up to a week in advance so I can reserve either for today
or all the way up to May 23rd. If I try and do beyond that week it won't let me submit
reservations yet but to reserve a time for today I'll hit reserve now. It will ask me for my library
card number and PIN. If you're not sure what your PIN is give the library call. We can assist you
in figuring that out and resetting it if needed. And then on the next page it'll ask a couple of
additional questions. It'll ask have you signed the waiver. It'll ask if you've completed the
training or if this reservation is for your badge project reservation and then you'll be able to hit
submit and you'll have a reserved time. Like we mentioned in previous videos the first thing
you'll do when you get to the library at your assigned time is check in at the lab desk and
they'll check your materials make sure we have all the documentation we need and then you'll be able
to hop on and start using the laser. Thank you for joining us for the X-Tool training. If you ever
have any questions stop by the lab desk and see us. We're happy to talk through whatever questions
you might have and I hope to see you around the workbench.
